persevere in faith to the very end. Let's pray. Our Lord Jesus, we praise You as the
Lord of creation, praise You as the God who reigns over our lives, who sits on
the throne with complete authority over everything that's going on in our
lives. Lord, you reign over your church and you reign over this world and you
care for us and you love your people. And so Lord we entrust ourselves to you and
Lord we pray that you would strengthen our faith. Lord we pray that you would
give us a faith that shows the world the kind of King that you are. Oh God we
pray that we would go from here marveling at your power and your love displayed through
Jesus Christ, displayed through your care for us in Him.
And we pray all this in Christ's name, Amen.
